info.title: RouteShareApp Admin Web API
info.description: OpenAPI contract consumed by the Admin Web application. Admin authorization uses Keycloak roles plus backend audit logging for every mutation.

get.summary: List queued data export and account deletion requests

200.description: Account requests visible to authorised operations staff

get.summary: Read a booking chat through the audited support path

200.description: Messages returned and an admin-read audit row recorded

400.description: A valid audit reason is required

get.summary: Get booking detail with status/payment history

post.description: Stops the driver driving and revokes the DRIVER realm role. Their rider account, and any money already earned, are untouched (board D34). Idempotent: an already-deactivated driver keeps the original case reference.
Clears the deactivation, restores the DRIVER realm role, and closes any open reinstatement request. Audited with actor and case reference.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Decision note recorded against the request.

put.description: Trip-start radius semantics from slice 09. The 20 km ceiling is a product decision - past it a driver is making a trip for the rider rather than sharing one - so no operator setting may exceed it, and the default must be one of the offered chips.

get.summary: Riders waiting on an identity decision
get.description: Oldest first. The queue exists because the camera-only rule is deterrence, not proof — a client can lie about where an image came from, so a human has to look at the selfie beside the NIC.

post.summary: Approve or reject a rider's identity verification
post.description: Approval writes the gender read off the NIC — the one value in the system a reviewer sets on somebody else's behalf, and the one that decides whether she may ride in a women-only car. Every decision is audited with the reviewer, the per-step outcomes and the gender written. The NIC image itself is never returned in a list response and never leaves the private bucket except by a short-lived presigned URL.

get.summary: Stuck authorisations and unfinished gateway calls
get.description: A hold that is never captured and never voided keeps a rider's money for as long as their bank allows. Nobody involved notices on their own, so operations are shown it here.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: One of the five penalty kinds

get.description: The curated tier is worth an operator's time because it is the only one that produces a real landmark name: a derived point can only be labelled by its address, since a Places displayName is Pro-tier and one Pro field re-prices the whole request.

post.description: Every curated corner is a corner that never reaches Google Places. Seeding the launch corridors is a cost control as much as a data load.

get.description: Commission, route-match discount tiers, penalty percentages, waiting times and payout floors. Every figure the product states as a rule lives here so it can be corrected without a deploy.

put.description: Restricted to ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN and FINANCE_ADMIN: changing the commission changes what every driver earns on their next trip. Audited with old and new value, and kept in a history table.

400.description: Value is not valid for this setting's type

post.description: APPROVED with new numbers writes a new band; REJECTED leaves the live band exactly as it was. Either way the vehicle keeps earning throughout.

get.summary: Get FINANCE or OPERATIONS analytics report
List live active trips for operations dashboard

post.summary: Admin cancel/interrupt trip with audit reason

put.description: Sets the per-km band and activates it, defaulting the driver's rate to the midpoint so the vehicle is publishable immediately. Restricted to ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN and FINANCE_ADMIN: approving papers and setting a price are different authorities. Audited with before and after values.

409.description: BAND_OUTSIDE_CLASS — the band is outside the vehicle class's range

AdminDriverDeactivation.description: A driver stopped from driving. Riding and pending payouts are deliberately unaffected.

reason.description: Shown to the driver on D34 — user-safe wording only.

caseRef.description: The reference the driver quotes when they appeal.

AdminPenalty.description: An assessed penalty with the whole computation beside it — base, percentage, fee and both halves. A fee an agent cannot explain in the caller's own numbers is a refund.

AdminPenaltyDisputeDecision.description: Reversal defaults to the whole fee. A partial exists for the case where some of it was fair and some was not, which only a person can judge.

reverseAmount.description: Capped at the fee; omit to reverse all of it

AdminRateBandAssessment.description: An admin's assessment. The band is typed directly (decision D2); the factors explain it to the driver and are never used to compute it.

AdminStuckPayment.description: Money nobody is watching: a hold that was never captured or released, or a gateway call whose outcome is unknown.

gender.description: Read off the NIC on approval. An eligibility input only — it appears in no rider-facing payload.

rejectedSteps.description: Naming the step matters: 'try again' over four images is a rider who will get it wrong a second time.

x-routeShareContractStatus.note: Updated after comparing business requirements and passenger/driver design assets; some paths are planned contract endpoints and may not yet be implemented in apps/api.
